unresolved.finding: The rewind comparison only prints numerical differences, so arbitrarily different restored results can pass the test.
Empty ndarray values enter the scalar fallback and NaN differences fail the greater-than check, leaving these results without a reliable validation outcome.
The two final simulation times are saved as t1a and t1b but never compared.
Both integration loops have no iteration limit or progress assertion, so a timestep regression that stops advancing time can hang the suite.
The array setter test writes existing array values back without checking a changed value, allowing a no-op setter to pass.
The test hardcodes a versioned library build path and a fixture in branches/rewind, making its setup dependent on that particular source-tree layout.
Test import unconditionally loads matplotlib and enables interactive plotting even though no test uses plotting.
The character array constructor mixes one- and two-character literals without an explicit constructor type specification, which can be rejected for inconsistent element lengths.
The demo assumes xz is rank one and cx is rank three, an allocation and indexing contract that needs checking against the current spacepars definition.
The comment promises to zero only the first element, but setvar assigns the supplied value to the entire selected scalar or array.
The comments label the real branch as integer and the integer branch as real*8.
The type and rank dispatches have no default error path, so unsupported descriptors produce a setting message without performing an assignment.
Non-master ranks allocate aa and iaa as 1-by-1 and vvs with two elements but pass global-sized sections of those arrays, exceeding their allocated bounds before any callee master guard applies.
xshiftest resets errors before each array type and rank, so the final reduced total includes only the last integer rank-three case.
Detected comparison failures are only printed and never propagated to a failing program exit status.
shifttest repeats border exchange 100 times after poisoning halos only once, allowing a defect that requires multiple exchanges to repair the halos to pass.
getrowtest fills every cell on a process with the same process-row value, so selecting the wrong local row or permuting its columns can pass.
The vector mismatch diagnostic prints fill1(is(rank+1)) instead of the indexed expected value actually used in the comparison.
Shift payloads add rank and indices without distinct positional weights, allowing some wrong-source and index-offset combinations to produce the same expected value.
The shift tests access index 2 and size-minus-one without establishing a minimum local extent, while the explicit processor-grid guard checks only the process-count product.
The script runs the executable and opens the report without checking directory-change or launch success, allowing a failed invocation to display an old report.
Completion is inferred from all processes with the executable name rather than the launched process, so concurrent runs interfere and no test exit status is captured.
The tasklist polling loop has neither a delay nor a timeout and can spin indefinitely while a matching process remains.
Both directory changes omit cd /d, so a SolutionDir on another Windows drive does not switch the active drive.
The script searches bin/ConfigurationName although the test project places executables under bin/win32/ConfigurationName or bin/x64/ConfigurationName.
The only interpolation case samples the exact midpoint of two points, so an implementation that always averages the endpoints can pass.
